name: malo-browser
description: Scripted browser demo tool and agent browser runtime: a visible Electron stage for live web demos, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console, a loopback control API, and a background daemon that hands out port leases with isolated browser sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Open, drive and record pages in a scripted browser
interface.longDescription: Malo Browser runs a scripted Electron stage for live web demos, hidden 1920x1080@30fps recording with evidence files, a React director console and a loopback control API. Its daemon mode issues per-agent port leases so several agents can drive isolated browser sessions at the same time.
